examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Velocity of a Particle
examples.problem: The position $x$ of a particle at time $t$ is given by $x(t) = 3t^2 +3t +1.$ Calculate the velocity at time $t.$
examples.worked_solution:
The velocity is the derivative of the position function $x(t)$ with respect to time:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(t) & =\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t} \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(3{t}^{2}+3t+1) \\  & =6t+3\end{aligned}
$$
